name: smwpatches-event-path-reveal-speed-customizer
title: Event Path Reveal Speed Customizer
description:
This lets you customize the path reveal speed of every individual event in the overworld. Slow events are no longer conditioned to Forest of Illusion!
This is compatible with the vanilla event fade, so you can reproduce the two vanilla speeds and two more intermediary ones. Disabling the path fade, however, gives you a bigger array of speeds (as many as Lunar Magic does).
